name: resize-windows
title: Resize Windows
description: Arrange the windows on the current screen side by side in columns with custom proportions, e.g. 1:2:1.
author: kiwi

commands.name: resize
commands.title: Resize Windows
commands.subtitle: Proportional Columns
commands.description: Arrange windows horizontally in the given proportions, e.g. 1:2:1. Can also be used as a fallback command with ":resize 1:2:1".

preferences.name: gap
preferences.title: Gap
preferences.description: Space in pixels between windows and around the screen edges.
